dashboard.purpose: Monitor a small, truthful set of operational signals and decide the next action.

entity-list.purpose: Resolve a comparable collection of records into a searchable, filterable, selectable workspace with contextual detail.

shell.selectionRule: Use AppShell when persistent workspace navigation and operational density are part of the task.

conditional.Sidebar: required when the consumer has persistent workspace navigation; omit for an embedded list surface.
conditional.KPICluster: include when a small set of decision metrics frames the collection before scanning rows.
conditional.FilterToolbar: include when search plus one or more filters, sort, or result actions are required.
conditional.Pagination: include when the collection is server-paged or exceeds the visible row budget.
conditional.BulkActionBar: include when selection enables one or more actions across records.
conditional.DetailDrawer: include when a record can be inspected without losing list context.

forbid: unbounded card gallery for comparable records

rationale.AppShell: The reference intent is a persistent operational workspace, not a standalone marketing route.
rationale.PageHeader: The collection needs an accountable title, context, and route-level actions.
rationale.DataTable: Rows must remain comparable across stable columns and support semantic sort and selection.
rationale.FilterToolbar: Query controls stay adjacent to the collection so the result context remains visible.
rationale.DetailDrawer: Quick inspection preserves list position and avoids forcing every record into a new route.

entity-detail.purpose: Read and act on one structured record without inventing a new data grammar.

shell.selectionRule: Use AppShell for an operational record with persistent workspace context; use PublicShell or route navigation for a read-only record outside the workspace.

conditional.AppShell: include when the record belongs to a persistent authenticated workspace; omit for an independent route or embedded detail surface.
conditional.Sidebar: include when workspace navigation must remain available while the record is inspected.
conditional.StatusChip: include when the record exposes a current status that changes the next decision.
conditional.ActivityFeed: include when record history or an audit trail is part of the inspection task.
conditional.ActionMenu: include when several contextual record actions should remain compact and close to the summary.
conditional.ActionFooter: include when the record has a meaningful primary or secondary decision at the end of the inspection.
conditional.DataTable: include when related records need stable cross-row comparison rather than a prose link list.
conditional.Alert: include when a persistent record-level warning or permission message must remain visible.
conditional.Modal: include when a short confirmation is required before a record action completes.

forbid: unbounded property grid without a record summary

rationale.PageHeader: The route needs accountable context and navigation before the record is inspected.
rationale.RecordSummary: A single record needs a scannable identity and decision context before its attributes.
rationale.KeyValueList: Stable facts belong in the canonical description-list contract rather than ad hoc rows.
rationale.ActivityFeed: History is conditional so read-only records do not inherit operational density without evidence.
rationale.ActionFooter: Actions remain an explicit end boundary and are omitted when the record is strictly read-only.

entity-form.purpose: Create or edit one structured record through grouped, labelled ten4seven controls.

master-detail.purpose: Keep a record list visible while inspecting or updating one selected record.

approval-queue.purpose: Review, approve, reject, and safely bulk-operate on pending records.

settings.purpose: Edit application, workspace, or personal preferences.

report.purpose: Inspect a time-bounded result set and export a supported report.

catalog.purpose: Browse visual products, courses, books, or media with content-first composition.

shell.selectionRule: Use PublicShell for a public, content-first storefront; choose AppShell only when the catalog is inside a persistent authenticated workspace.

product-detail.purpose: Present one product with media, record context, price, and bounded purchase or save actions.

checkout.purpose: Collect the information needed to confirm an order without owning cart or payment business state.

content-list.purpose: Browse articles, lessons, documents, or media without forcing table semantics.

content-detail.purpose: Read one article, lesson, or document with clear metadata and bounded supporting actions.

ebook-reader.purpose: Read an ebook while preserving progress and reader controls.

auth.purpose: Sign in, register, recover access, or verify identity.

shell.selectionRule: Use PublicShell for an entry route; use AppShell only when authentication is embedded in a persistent workspace.

rationale.Surface: Authentication needs one broad semantic region that can host the brand expression and form without forking controls.
rationale.Input: The route collects a labelled identifier while preserving the shared input contract.
rationale.PasswordInput: Credential entry uses the canonical visibility toggle and native password semantics.
rationale.ActionFooter: Primary submit and recovery actions remain grouped at the end of the task.

marketing-home.purpose: Explain a product through reusable expressive sections and drive one primary acquisition action.

shell.selectionRule: Use PublicShell for a public acquisition surface; keep block order and page-level actions in the recipe rather than rebuilding a shell locally.

cart.purpose: Review selected products, adjust bounded quantities, and continue to checkout without owning commerce persistence.
